metadata.title: ZEPHIRUM v1.9.0 and ZYQL trivalent decision core: quantum language with receipts — software record and thesis v0.1
metadata.description:
ZEPHIRUM v1.9.0 — the quantum programming language with receipts. Trivalent decisions (1 / 0 / REFUSED) read from Deutsch-Jozsa interference, with adaptive Hoeffding margins, a GHZ device-trust gate that interrogates the QPU before every verdict, tamper-evident provenance chains, and three-layer post-quantum cryptography: SHA3-256 integrity, ML-DSA-44 (FIPS 204) authenticity and ML-KEM-768 (FIPS 203) confidentiality (Z-KEM).

Validated on three IBM Heron quantum processors (ibm_fez, ibm_kingston, ibm_marrakesh) with citable job IDs: GHZ fidelity 0.977, exact trivalent battery at n=4/5/6 qubits (1024 shots, adaptive band), Bernstein-Vazirani secret recovery, Grover dominance. Production runtime ~3.4k decisions/s with offline-verifiable receipts. Poliglota core cross-validated in 6 quantum languages (Qiskit, OpenQASM 3, Cirq, PennyLane, Braket, Q#).

Includes the thesis draft Necessity-First Computational Quantum Chemistry: The ZYQL Exact-Decision Language and Quantum-Witnessed Verification on Superconducting Hardware (v0.1).
